checks.message: Same-currency price observations sit within 1.5% of the catalog from-price. Wider gaps fail. Cross-currency figures are not converted.
From-prices share one unit (per_person).
Every product has a duration.
Every product has a cancellation statement.
Some products do not state a meeting point or say that pickup is not included.
Pickup or transfers are marked as depending on the option selected. The collection card does not name the meeting point.
These cards publish a duration range at least 3× wide and at least 3 hours across. The from-price is then hard to read as one experience.

The page says “Experience a 2-hour Milford Sound Cruise with a view of the iconic Mitre Peak.” (2 hours). The lead card Milford Sound Cruise with Optional Lunch is 1 hr 40 mins - 6 hrs. The claimed length sits inside that range, so the line is not false, but it hides the range.
11 of 24 products have 0 reviews on the collection card.
These product titles do not contain the collection scope keywords (milford). Confirm they belong on this collection.
This spec is a headout.com collection, so the official-versus-reseller line is the marketplace frame.

No FAQ question and answer was confirmed in the fetched page. The collection SSR payload's long-form body was empty, which matches other Headout collection pages, so a client-rendered guide may still exist.
A fetched product page says the cruise is not fully wheelchair accessible. The confirmed collection copy does not say so.

Viator lists “Cruise Milford NZ small boutique cruise, and other fiord cruises” from 88 USD. Comparability is 'currency_unknown'. The listing page showed from-prices in US dollars, from about US$88 for a RealNZ cruise and US$103 for a small-boat cruise. Not compared with the NZD catalog.

GetYourGuide lists “From Queenstown: Milford Sound Discover More Longest Cruise” from 188 None. Comparability is 'currency_unknown'. Southern Discoveries coach-and-cruise, about 13.5 hours, from $188 per person. The fetched page did not confirm the currency.
1 product pair(s) share a duration, a from-price within 12%, and a title overlap of at least 62%. Review whether both need to sit on the collection. First pairs: 56773 vs 55218 (J=0.75)
